company_summary.Category: All-in-one digital workspace (design, docs, collaboration, AI, project management)
company_summary.Target Customers: Individuals, creators, marketing/design teams, project teams, and enterprises
company_summary.Core Product: A unified workspace combining design, documents, collaboration, AI content tools and project tracking in a single product family.
company_summary.Key Differentiators: Blends collaboration, design and AI patterns common across Figma/Notion/Canva (80% of capabilities), plus five original capabilities not offered by any of the three (voice-to-design generation, an offline-first sync engine, a cross-team sentiment dashboard, regulatory compliance templates, and a creator micro-licensing marketplace).
company_summary.Similarity Note: ~80% structurally/feature similar to Figma/Notion/Canva patterns; ~20% original — see Similarity_Summary tab for the calculated split.

product_features.Description: Multiple users edit the same document or design simultaneously with live cursors and changes.
Large library of ready-made templates for social, presentation and marketing content.
Generates on-brand images, copy and design variants from a text prompt.
Drafts, rewrites, summarizes and translates text inline within documents.
Centralizes logos, fonts, colors and templates for consistent branded output.
Creates slide decks using templates, shared assets and AI-generated content.
Pages and blocks for docs, notes and structured content in one workspace.
Databases and boards for tracking tasks, owners, and statuses.
Visual charts and dashboards summarizing project and workspace data.
Share files and folders internally or via public links with permission controls.
Contextual comments and @mentions on documents, designs and tasks.
Tracks and restores previous versions of documents and designs.
product_features.Modeled On / Basis: Notion page history / Figma version history

product_features.Description: Unified search across documents, designs, tasks and connected content.
Rule-based automations that trigger actions on database or status changes.
Connects to common third-party apps such as Slack, Google Drive and Jira.
Public API and webhooks for building custom integrations.
Centralized administration for members, workspaces and settings.
SAML-based SSO for enterprise identity providers.
Granular permissions by role across workspaces and content.
Cloud-hosted storage for files, designs and documents with tiered limits.
Converts a spoken creative brief directly into a layered, editable design draft.
Full offline editing across documents, designs and tasks with automatic conflict-free merge on reconnect.
product_features.Modeled On / Basis: Original — addresses the 'no true offline mode' gap noted in Notion's customer feedback

product_features.Description: Aggregates comments and feedback across a workspace into a live team sentiment score.
Pre-built templates and workflows aligned to industry compliance requirements (e.g. healthcare, finance).
Lets creators license individual design assets to other workspace users for a revenue share.

pricing.Description: Core workspace access with limited storage and limited AI usage.
pricing.Modeled On / Basis: Free tier pattern common to Figma/Notion/Canva

pricing.Description: Advanced creation, collaboration, analytics and higher AI limits.
pricing.Modeled On / Basis: Individual paid-tier pattern (Figma Professional / Canva Pro)

pricing.Description: Shared workspace, administration, collaboration and team analytics.
Security, SSO, governance, onboarding, SLA and dedicated support.
A single-use pass unlocking full features for one project with no recurring subscription.
pricing.Modeled On / Basis: Original — none of Figma/Notion/Canva offer a one-time per-project purchase option

customer_feedback.Feedback: Brings design, documents and AI tools into one workspace and cuts down tool switching.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: Learning the full workspace takes time.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: accessibility/speed of creation (Canva feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: Real-time collaboration is useful for distributed project work.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: More advanced workflow automation would help.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: real-time collaboration praise (Figma feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: Templates and brand controls make campaign production noticeably faster.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: More niche industry templates are requested.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: template speed (Canva feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: The free plan is easy to start with and the interface is simple.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: Storage limits are noticeable on larger projects.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: freemium accessibility (Canva feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: The shared workspace improves feedback cycles and version control.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: Advanced prototyping controls could be expanded.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: prototyping/collaboration depth (Figma feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: Admin controls and centralized workspaces are valuable for managing multiple teams.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: enterprise governance (common theme)

customer_feedback.Feedback: AI assistance speeds up first drafts and content ideation.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: More control over AI output style is desired.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: AI-assisted creation (Canva/Notion feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: Dashboards and task views make project status easier to track.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: Additional integrations would improve workflow continuity.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Echoes Master_Sheet theme: data-to-insight workflows (Notion feedback)

customer_feedback.Feedback: The offline sync engine finally let the team keep working during a week with no reliable internet, with nothing lost on reconnect.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Original — no equivalent theme exists in Master_Sheet (directly contrasts Notion's documented 'no offline mode' pain point)

customer_feedback.Feedback: The micro-licensing marketplace is a promising extra income stream, but payout thresholds and licensing terms need clearer documentation.
customer_feedback.Pain Point: Marketplace payout and licensing terms are confusing.
customer_feedback.Modeled On / Basis: Original — no equivalent theme exists in Master_Sheet
